attributes.description: A small circular dot/ring glyph representing the Pali/Sanskrit niggahita (anusvara) diacritic mark, used in Thai-script Pali transliteration. Renders as a tiny open circle (วงกลมเล็ก) typically placed above a consonant to indicate a nasal sound.
attributes.purpose: UI icon resource for inserting or representing the niggahita diacritic in the E-Tipitaka search/reader interface, likely used to support Pali text input or display in the Thai Tipitaka reading application.
attributes.domain: Pali script / Thai Buddhist scripture rendering
attributes.rationale: E-Tipitaka deals with Pali Tipitaka texts; the niggahita ('นิคหิต' / ํ) is a special character not always easy to type, so a dedicated icon/button asset facilitates input or visual marking in the UI.
